verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Caveman publishes an OpenAPI spec at docs.caveman.so/openapi.json, so a documented programmatic API exists. Nothing shows which UI features it covers: agent tabs, automations, budgets and caps, roles, audit log, and cost lookup are described only as product features, not API endpoints. The base-URL swap is an LLM proxy connection, not a management API, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: evidence of which endpoints the OpenAPI spec exposes, documented API coverage of UI features (automations, budgets/guardrails, keys/roles, billing/cost lookup, Cloud computers), an explicit API-parity statement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
